Preconditions / Test Data: Synthetic data only.
Steps: Complete registration, then refresh browser.
Expected Result: Previously entered local draft data is restored after refresh.

Preconditions / Test Data: Use Chrome DevTools Network Offline.

Expected Result: Draft synchronizes to server successfully and remains available after another refresh.

Preconditions / Test Data: Valid small PDF file under configured upload limit.

Expected Result: PDF upload succeeds and document reaches expected scan/upload state.

Preconditions / Test Data: Valid JPG file under configured upload limit.

Preconditions / Test Data: Valid PNG file under configured upload limit.

Expected Result: PNG upload succeeds and document reaches expected scan/upload state.

Expected Result: Invalid file is rejected with a clear message. No accepted/scanned state is shown.

Expected Result: Oversized file is rejected with a clear message. No accepted/scanned state is shown.

Preconditions / Test Data: Synthetic application with required documents complete. Fake/sandbox payment only.

Expected Result: Payment attempt/order is created once and user sees safe payment/retry guidance.

Preconditions / Test Data: Payment attempt started but not completed.
Steps: Refresh page, return to payment step, click retry/check status.
Expected Result: Duplicate charge/order is not initiated. Existing payment attempt is reused.

Preconditions / Test Data: Fake/sandbox provider callback only. Use attempt/order IDs from test application.

Preconditions / Test Data: Payment callback already completed.
Steps: Refresh portal status page after paid state.
Expected Result: Paid state remains visible after refresh.

Expected Result: Guardian completes primary flow without staff help, or all usability blockers are recorded as defects.
